northStar: Determine whether Cloudflare can turn an existing OpenAPI API into a safe native WebMCP interface without changing the API implementation.
proven: Explicitly enabled OpenAPI operations can become native WebMCP tools in Chrome 151 and reach an unchanged API.
A same-origin external bootstrap works under script-src self, and a nonce-bearing external bootstrap works under a nonce-only policy without rewriting CSP.
Cloudflare can generate a same-origin companion document for a JSON-only API.
Ten tested OpenAPI-style schema shapes registered, were natively discovered, and completed native invocations.
An edge-held origin credential can remain absent from the page, tool input, native events, manifest, and receipt while a protected origin call succeeds.
Path encoding, scalar query parameters, JSON bodies, and HTTP error status matched an independent origin.
An edge policy can deny a native call before an independent protected origin sees a request.
A native write can wait for separate exact-intent approval, execute once, and reject replay before another origin call.
A live page can add a replacement native tool, retire the old tool, emit removal, and make the old descriptor unusable.
Chrome 151 discovered exact generated tool sets through 2000 tools and completed first and final calls.
falsified: Inline injection works under script-src self.
Hash-only CSP permits Mulder injection without an origin-provided hash or policy rewrite.
A JSON API document can itself publish native WebMCP tools.
Chrome registration means Chrome enforces JSON Schema constraints before tool execution.
The current compiler has general OpenAPI request fidelity.
Native WebMCP supplies an edge-verifiable agent principal distinct from the browser session.
partial: Request fidelity passes for path, scalar query, JSON, and HTTP errors but fails or is unsupported for array query, headers, and multipart.
Credential custody, edge denial, and write approval are local proofs rather than deployed production proofs.
The tool-count experiment found no failure through 2000 and therefore records a tested ceiling, not an absolute browser maximum.
nextPhase: Choose a product claim from the evidence. Do not claim that an API itself becomes WebMCP, that Chrome validates inputs, that every CSP works, or that native WebMCP identifies the calling agent.
